kubectl_manifest.cluster_pca_issuer must wait for module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons to install the AWSPCAClusterIssuer CRD; referencing the cluster and CA does not order CRD installation.

kubectl_manifest.cluster_pca_issuer should wait for aws_acmpca_certificate_authority_certificate.example to activate the root CA before its controller attempts to use it; the CA ARN reference only waits for the uninitialized authority.
aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng already references aws_iam_role.managed_ng through node_role_arn; the explicit role dependency duplicates that ordering.
aws_launch_template.managed_node_groups already waits for aws_iam_role.managed_ng through its dependency on aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.managed_ng, which references the role.
aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng already depends on aws_iam_instance_profile.self_managed_ng through the launch-template outputs and launch_template_config input.
aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng already waits for aws_iam_role.self_managed_ng transitively through its launch template and instance profile, as well as its policy attachment dependency.
null_resource.update_trust_policy already references aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution in its provisioner command, so its explicit dependency is redundant.
null_resource.update_trust_policy already references kubernetes_namespace.spark in its provisioner command, so its explicit dependency is redundant.
kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth already waits for module.aws_eks through data.http.eks_cluster_readiness and data.aws_eks_cluster.cluster.
kubernetes_config_map.amazon_vpc_cni already waits for module.aws_eks through data.http.eks_cluster_readiness and data.aws_eks_cluster.cluster.
kubectl_manifest.aws_provider_config already waits for kubectl_manifest.aws_provider through time_sleep.wait_30_seconds.

The self-managed CoreDNS Helm release must wait for null_resource.modify_kube_dns to annotate and label the existing kube-dns service for Helm ownership. Waiting only for removal of the default deployment permits Helm to race the ownership update.
module.cert_manager_csi_driver installs into the cert-manager namespace without creating it. It must wait for module.cert_manager, which creates that namespace and installs cert-manager.
aws_eks_addon.adot must wait for kubernetes_role_binding_v1.adot: creating the Role alone does not grant eks:addon-manager the permissions needed to install the add-on.
aws_eks_addon.adot must wait for kubernetes_cluster_role_binding_v1.adot: the referenced ClusterRole does not authorize eks:addon-manager until the binding exists.
